channel.title: Hürriyet Daily News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Hürriyet Daily News (hurriyetdailynews.com)

item.title: Fazıl Say premieres latest work in Istanbul
item.description: At his traditional year-end concert in Istanbul, the acclaimed pianist and composer drew attention to the climate crisis and global conflicts through Türkiye premieres of his latest work

item.title: Ankara hosts Grand Atatürk Run to mark 106 years since founder’s arrival
item.description: Ankara has marked the 106th anniversary of modern Türkiye founder Mustafa Kemal Atatürk’s arrival in the province with the 90th edition of the Grand Atatürk Run, a long-standing road race that has become a centerpiece of the capital’s annual commemorations.

item.title: New regulation requires detailed proof for high-value bank transfers
item.description: Money transfers of 200,000 Turkish Liras (around $4,600) and above will require banks to record both the source of the funds and the stated purpose of the transaction starting Jan. 1, 2026, under a new regulation introduced by Türkiye’s Financial Crimes Investigation Board (MASAK).

item.title: Türkiye’s Kızılelma achieves world 1st autonomous close-formation flight
item.description: Turkish defense company Baykar announced on Dec. 28 that two prototypes of its Bayraktar Kızılelma unmanned combat aircraft have successfully carried out the world’s first fully autonomous close-formation flight by jet-powered drones.

item.title: Erdoğan marks handover of 455,000th house in quake-hit region
item.description: President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan has marked the delivery of the 455,000th new house built for survivors of the catastrophic 2023 earthquakes in Türkiye's south.

item.title: Nearly half million loggerhead turtle hatchlings reach sea in Antalya
item.description: Nearly half a million loggerhead sea turtle (Caretta caretta) hatchlings have reached the Mediterranean this year from nesting beaches in Türkiye’s southern province of Antalya, one of the species’ most important breeding grounds in the region.

item.title: Hundreds of village roads closed as severe snowstorm grips rural Türkiye
item.description: A brutal winter wave sweeping in from Russia has paralyzed life across the rural parts of eastern and central Türkiye, burying hundreds of roads under heavy snow and leaving remote communities isolated as temperatures plummet.

item.title: Automotive sector set for continued growth, record sales in 2026
item.description: Industry officials predict Türkiye's automotive market will maintain its growth trend for the next two to three years, including 2026, forecasting new records each year.

item.title: Bodrum yacht manufacturing continues year-round, bolstering exports
item.description: Yacht and boat production in luxury workshops and shipyards in the southwestern province of Muğla's Bodrum district continues unabated through the winter season.

item.title: Israel faces global fury over Somaliland move
item.description: Somalia and the African Union reacted angrily Friday after Israel formally recognised the northern region of Somaliland as an "independent and sovereign state" — the first country to do so.
